posts.title: Pruning my creative services, again
posts.description: 10 years ago I transformed my creative services, and that change improved both my work quality and enjoment. Those changes worked pretty well for a while, but another change is long overdue: I no longer offer website design & development services.

posts.title: Easy things to do when you’re not able to make art
posts.description: Living with chronic illness means that sometimes we may have a bit of time to create, but not the energy or mental capacity. Even when I have an hour or two to myself, it doesn’t mean I can just dive in and start drawing or painting. So what's the easiest thing we can do instead, that still helps us move forward with our creative practice?

posts.title: 12 symbolic & monogram logo sketches + final logo designs
posts.description: I always start my logo design projects by sketching on paper. Here is a collection of my symbolic icons and monogram logo sketches that are the most similar to the final logos. Some are very rough while others are polished, but they all contain symbolism and mark a pivotal moment in a logo project's progress.
